Name: No Soil Decay
Author: ThatNorthernMonkey
Description:
Small quality of life mod whereby your tilled soil in the Farm and Greenhouse will remain tilled overnight and not decay!

[b]Requirements[/b]

[b]SMAPI 0.39.2 - [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/stardew-modding-api-0-39-2.108375/]Get SMAPI Here[/url][/b]

Place the NoSoilDecay folder and contents in your /Stardew Valley/Mods/ folder with both .dlls and the manifest.json.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/DrstoFl.gif[/img]

Downloads.Description: Tilled soil will no longer decay overnight!
